description: A real zenbot bug, fixed in 57f7b4a; the fix's test is hidden until the check.

steps.shell: git -C "$HOME/zenbot" archive 70b18fe Cargo.toml Cargo.lock crates | tar x && rm -rf crates/zen-matrix && mkdir -p .cargo && printf '[build]\ntarget-dir = "%s"\n' "$HOME/.zenbot/evals/cargo-target-zen" > .cargo/config.toml && git init -q && git add -A && git -c user.name=eval -c user.email=eval@local commit -qm base

steps.prompt: web_fetch garbles pages that aren't UTF-8: Brazilian sites served as ISO-8859-1 or Windows-1252 come out with replacement characters (São Paulo becomes S�o Paulo). Fix it in crates/zend/src/web.rs: decode the body by its charset, from the Content-Type header, else a <meta charset> in the page, else UTF-8 when the bytes are valid UTF-8, else Windows-1252. Put the decoding in `fn decode_page(body: &[u8], content_type: &str) -> String` (a unit test will call it) and use it where pages are decoded. No new dependencies.

checks.name: hidden test passes
checks.run: python3 "$TASK_DIR/../../lib/coding-zen-insert.py" crates/zend/src/web.rs "$TASK_DIR/hidden/test.rs" && out=$(cargo test -p zend --offline --bin zend -- legacy_pages_decode_from_their_charset 2>&1); echo "$out" | tail -15; echo "$out" | grep -q ' 1 passed'
